$comment: Where updates come from (QGD-FRM-0019, QGD-SEC-0020, docs/RELEASES.md). Built into the credential core, which is the only thing that reads it: the feed is asked at most once a day, and a download is accepted only from these hosts, after every redirect, and only when its SHA-256 matches the feed's. A host here is trusted to deliver bytes, never to say what they are: the feed says that. '*.' means any name under that domain. The domains are KI7MT's, so where each points can change without a release.
